import {expect, test} from 'vitest'
import {page} from 'vitest/browser'

test('a journey that sets its own waits', async () => {
  await expect.element(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Send'}), {timeout: 5000}).toBeVisible()
  await expect.poll(() => readCount(), {interval: 50}).toBe(1)
  await screen.findByRole('dialog', {}, {timeout: 1000})
  await waitFor(() => readCount(), {timeout: 1000})
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Send'})).toBeVisible({timeout: 1000})
  await expect(page.getByRole('status'), {timeout: 1000}).toHaveText('sent')
  await page.waitForTimeout(100)
  await wait(100)
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
})

test('a slow journey', {timeout: 60_000}, async () => {})

test('a numeric timeout', async () => {}, 30_000)

test('honest options and data stay clean', async () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers()
  const engine = startEngine({reconnect: {timeout: 10}})
  expect(engine.state).toEqual({type: 'timeout', timeout: 1})
  await expect.element(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Send'})).toBeVisible()
})
